title: Difference-in-differences with "bad controls"
abstract: arXiv:2608.03881v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper considers difference-in-differences identification strategies when the parallel trends assumption holds after conditioning on covariates that may themselves be affected by the treatment (often referred to as "bad controls"). We show that common approaches such as simply dropping bad controls are often ill-advised and develop two alternative approaches that allow bad controls to function as genuine controls despite being affected by treatment. First, we derive explicit conditions that rationalize conditioning only on pre-treatment values of the bad control, leading naturally to the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) estimator with pre-treatment values as covariates. Second, under a covariate unconfoundedness condition, we develop imputation and double/debiased machine learning estimators that recover the average treatment effect on the treated. translated_title: 含“坏控制变量”的双重差分法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了当平行趋势假设需要在以某些协变量为条件后才成立时的双重差分识别策略，而这些协变量本身可能受到处理的影响（通常被称为“坏控制变量”）。我们表明，诸如简单地剔除坏控制变量等常见做法往往并不可取，并提出了两种替代方法，使得坏控制变量尽管受到处理影响，仍能作为真正的控制变量发挥作用。首先，我们推导出明确的条件，使得仅以坏控制变量的处理前取值为条件具有合理性，这自然地引出了以处理前取值为协变量的 Callaway 和 Sant'Anna (2021) 估计量。其次，在协变量无混杂性条件下，我们开发了插补估计量和双重/去偏机器学习估计量，以识别处理组的平均处理效应。我们将这些结果扩展到交错采纳处理的情形，并为识别假设提供了前置检验方法。
tldr: 本文针对双重差分法中受处理影响的“坏控制变量”问题，提出了以处理前取值为条件进行控制以及基于无混杂性假设的插补和双重去偏机器学习两类新估计方法，并将结果扩展至交错采纳处理的情形。
